_metadata.description: P2 requirements — expansions deliberately deferred until the core loop has real data. Each exists because the workshop identified it as a genuine option, not as speculative scope; each is cheap to add on the same substrate once the P0 loop is proven.

requirements.title: Receipt distillation
requirements.description: Candidate memories distilled from the vrooli-events receipt stream for a completed run, surfaced for operator confirmation rather than written directly. Deliberately not the primary write path: distillation only reaches agent-manager-spawned agents, whereas the deliberate write verb covers every harness. Kept as a P2 because the substrate makes it a cheap experiment and the signal-to-noise question is empirical.

validation.notes: A completed run's receipts produce candidate memories in a pending state that are never journaled without confirmation.
Operator evaluation of candidate quality against a sample of runs before promoting this beyond an experiment.

requirements.title: Write-path enforcement hooks
requirements.description: Harness hooks that intercept direct writes to a memory file and redirect them through the governed CLI. Hardening only — the prompt block plus the generated projection are the primary mechanism, because hook APIs are runtime-specific and several supported harnesses have no equivalent. Building on hooks first would make adoption depend on a surface most runtimes do not expose.

validation.notes: A direct write to the projected memory path is intercepted and re-routed to the CLI write path.
Per-runtime review of which harnesses expose a usable pre-write hook surface.

requirements.title: Re-summarization drift monitoring
requirements.description: When re-summarizing a node above a configured depth, re-read a sample of its descendant leaves to detect fact mutation. Deferred by explicit decision: summaries are lossy by design, so dropping facts is intended compression and not a defect. The failure this would catch is narrower — a fact mutated into something false, which is indistinguishable from a drop in a diff and only detectable against the leaves.

validation.notes: Re-summarization above the configured depth samples descendant leaves and reports assertions present in leaves but negated in the summary.
Calibrate against real multi-generation compaction output; do not implement before that data exists.

requirements.title: Memory retrieval eval corpus
requirements.description: A golden retrieval suite registered with search-hub so memory recall quality is measured over time like any other provider — reviewed positive cases, junk negatives for rejection, and stored runs whose freshness and aggregate recall gate certification. Requires a real corpus first: a generated-only corpus cannot certify under the existing provider contract.

validation.notes: The registered suite runs against the live memory provider and stores a run with per-case labels.
Author reviewed positive and junk-negative cases from real memory content; generated cases remain candidates and do not count toward acceptance recall.
